data.action: 双手抱胸身体微前倾，眉头轻挑傲娇俯视
data.description: 【惣流·明日香 · 教室里的傲娇女王】课间嘈杂的教室窗边，明亮的日光倾泻在过道上。明日香双手抱胸站在课桌前，穿着精致的水手服与过膝黑丝袜，眉头微挑，红润的樱唇轻翘，神采飞扬地俯视着面前的同伴——「你到底是不是笨蛋啊？这点基础算式还要本天才亲自教你吗？还不快把笔记本拿过来！」
data.lighting: 教室大窗投射的温暖自然日光
data.promptProse: Asuka stands before a classroom desk with both arms crossed, lifting one brow as she looks down at her companion and their notebook. Her turquoise pinafore, white sailor blouse and red bow remain in the low cowboy view. Other desks and large windows extend behind. Warm natural daylight catches her red clips and animated face, placing soft window-frame shadows across the aisle beside the desk.
data.title: 惣流·明日香 · 教室里的傲娇女王
